title: Velvety Light Mediterranean Gelatin Pudding
description: A winey and pillowy light Mediterranean dessert featuring unflavored gelatin, lacquer glaze, and macrobiotic friendly ingredients, perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it soften for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the wine, honey, lemon juice, and olive oil, and heat over low heat, stirring until the honey dissolves.
Add the softened gelatin to the saucepan and stir until it is fully dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the rose water.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or until set.
Just before serving, sprinkle the pomegranate seeds and pine nuts over the top of the pudding.
Drizzle the lacquer glaze over the pudding in a zigzag pattern.
Garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves and serve chilled.
